```
# copy remote path $2 (forward slashes) from host $1 into local folder $3, masking user and computer names in text files
pull() {
  local host=$1 src=$2 dst=$3 un cn
  mkdir -p "$dst"
  scp -r -q "$host:$src" "$dst/" || return 1
  un=$(ssh "$host" 'echo %USERNAME%' | tr -d '\r\n'); cn=$(ssh "$host" 'echo %COMPUTERNAME%' | tr -d '\r\n')
  find "$dst" -type f \( -name '*.log' -o -name '*.txt' -o -name '*.ini' -o -name '*.csv' \) -print0 |
    xargs -0 -r sed -i -e "s#$un#USER#Ig" -e "s#$cn#PC#Ig"
}

step() {   # step <name of step> <host> <name> <log folder> [args...]
  local s=$1 host=$2 name=$3 logs=$4; shift 4
```

```
tmp='''	// SHELL1TMP A/B frame count: never committed. Hides and shows the hall every 2 s, counts frames in each state.
	{
		static bool bDone = false;
		if (!bDone && Room.GetWorld()->IsGameWorld())
		{
			bDone = true;
			UWorld* W = Room.GetWorld();
			TWeakObjectPtr<ASupercutHall> Weak(Hall);
			struct FAB { uint64 Frame = 0; double Time = 0; double Sum[2] = { 0, 0 }; uint64 Frames[2] = { 0, 0 }; int32 Phase = 0; };
			TSharedRef<FAB> AB = MakeShared<FAB>();
			for (int32 Step = 0; Step <= 10; ++Step)
			{
				FTimerHandle Handle;
				W->GetTimerManager().SetTimer(Handle, FTimerDelegate::CreateLambda([Weak, AB, Step, W]()
				{
					const double Now = FPlatformTime::Seconds();
					if (Step > 0)
					{
						const int32 State = (Step - 1) % 2;   // 0 hall shown, 1 hall hidden
						AB->Sum[State] += Now - AB->Time;
						AB->Frames[State] += GFrameCounter - AB->Frame;
					}
					if (Step == 10)
					{
						UE_LOG(LogSupercut, Display, TEXT("SHELL1TMP AB hall shown: %llu frames in %.2f s, %.3f ms; hidden: %llu frames in %.2f s, %.3f ms"),
							AB->Frames[0], AB->Sum[0], 1000.0 * AB->Sum[0] / FMath::Max<uint64>(AB->Frames[0], 1), AB->Frames[1], AB->Sum[1], 1000.0 * AB->Sum[1] / FMath::Max<uint64>(AB->Frames[1], 1));
						return;
					}
					if (Weak.IsValid())
					{
						Weak->SetActorHiddenInGame(Step % 2 == 1);
					}
					if (Step == 0 || Step == 1)
					{
						GEngine->Exec(W, TEXT("ProfileGPU"));
					}
					AB->Time = FPlatformTime::Seconds();
					AB->Frame = GFrameCounter;
				}), 3.f + Step * 2.f, false);
			}
		}
	}
	return Hall;'''
s=s.replace('\treturn Hall;',tmp,1)
open(p,'w',encoding='utf-8',newline='\r\n').write(s)
```

**Sat 14 Nov 22:09:47 · Tool call: Bash** (Package the final A/B build)

```
cd /d/UE/wt/shell1 && cp Source/Supercut/SupercutHall.cpp /d/UE/wt/shell1_farmlogs/SupercutHall.cpp.keep && python -I - <<'EOF'
p='Source/Supercut/SupercutHall.cpp'
s=open(p,encoding='utf-8').read()
s=s.replace('#include "Misc/Crc.h"\n','#include "Misc/Crc.h"\n#include "TimerManager.h"\n',1)
tmp='''	// SHELL1TMP A/B frame count: never committed. Hides and shows the hall every 2 s, counts frames in each state.
	{
		static bool bDone = false;
		if (!bDone && Room.GetWorld()->IsGameWorld())
		{
			bDone = true;
			UWorld* W = Room.GetWorld();
			TWeakObjectPtr<ASupercutHall> Weak(Hall);
			struct FAB { uint64 Frame = 0; double Time = 0; double Sum[2] = { 0, 0 }; uint64 Frames[2] = { 0, 0 }; };
			TSharedRef<FAB> AB = MakeShared<FAB>();
			for (int32 Step = 0; Step <= 10; ++Step)
			{
				FTimerHandle Handle;
				W->GetTimerManager().SetTimer(Handle, FTimerDelegate::CreateLambda([Weak, AB, Step]()
				{
					const double Now = FPlatformTime::Seconds();
					if (Step > 0)
					{
						const int32 State = (Step - 1) % 2;
						AB->Sum[State] += Now - AB->Time;
						AB->Frames[State] += GFrameCounter - AB->Frame;
					}
					if (Step == 10)
					{
						UE_LOG(LogSupercut, Display, TEXT("SHELL1TMP AB hall shown: %llu frames in %.2f s, %.3f ms; hidden: %llu frames in %.2f s, %.3f ms"),
							AB->Frames[0], AB->Sum[0], 1000.0 * AB->Sum[0] / FMath::Max<uint64>(AB->Frames[0], 1), AB->Frames[1], AB->Sum[1], 1000.0 * AB->Sum[1] / FMath::Max<uint64>(AB->Frames[1], 1));
						return;
					}
					if (Weak.IsValid())
					{
						Weak->SetActorHiddenInGame(Step % 2 == 1);
					}
					AB->Time = FPlatformTime::Seconds();
					AB->Frame = GFrameCounter;
				}), 3.f + Step * 2.f, false);
			}
		}
	}
	return Hall;'''
s=s.replace('\treturn Hall;',tmp,1)
open(p,'w',encoding='utf-8',newline='\r\n').write(s)
EOF
```

```
#!/bin/bash
# farm.sh: build, test, package and run a SUPERCUT project copy on a farm PC, driven from c4. Details: ../FARM.md.
#
#   farm.sh mirror  <host> <name> <project folder on c4>     copy the project to <root>\Farm\<name> (changed files only)
#   farm.sh build   <host> <name> <log folder> [build.ps1 args, e.g. -Target Supercut -Jobs 8]
#   farm.sh test    <host> <name> <log folder> [run_tests.ps1 args, e.g. -Filter Supercut.Rooms]
#   farm.sh package <host> <name> <log folder>               Tools\package.cmd   -> <root>\Farm\_builds\<name>\Supercut59
#   farm.sh package-shipping <host> <name> <log folder>      Tools\package_shipping.cmd -> ...\_builds\<name>\Supercut59_ship
#   farm.sh run     <host> <name> <log folder> [run_demo.ps1 args]   {P} = the mirror folder there, e.g. -Script {P}\Script\main8.txt
#   farm.sh fetch   <host> <name> <remote path> <local folder>   path in the mirror, or builds/... or out/...
#   farm.sh status  <host>
#
# Each step brings its logs back to <log folder>/<step>/ and exits with the remote step's exit code.
# Logs that come back have the PC's user and computer names replaced by USER and PC.
set -u
here=$(cd "$(dirname "$0")" && pwd)

root_of() {   # one line per farm PC: ssh alias, root folder there (engine in <root>\UE_5.9, mirrors in <root>\Farm)
  case "$1" in
    [pc-b]) echo 'C:\UE' ;;
    pc2)    echo 'C:\UE' ;;
    [pc-c])   echo 'F:\UE' ;;
    pc4)    echo 'C:\UE' ;;
    *) echo "FARM unknown host '$1' ([pc-b], pc2, [pc-c], pc4)" >&2; exit 64 ;;
  esac
}
fwd() { echo "${1//\\//}"; }   # C:\UE -> C:/UE for scp and tar

# copy remote path $2 (forward slashes) from host $1 into local folder $3, masking user and computer names in text files
pull() {
  local host=$1 src=$2 dst=$3 un cn
  mkdir -p "$dst"
  scp -r -q "$host:$src" "$dst/" || return 1
  un=$(ssh "$host" 'echo %USERNAME%' | tr -d '\r\n'); cn=$(ssh "$host" 'echo %COMPUTERNAME%' | tr -d '\r\n')
  find "$dst" -type f \( -name '*.log' -o -name '*.txt' -o -name '*.ini' -o -name '*.csv' \) -print0 |
    xargs -0 -r sed -i -e "s#$un#USER#Ig" -e "s#$cn#PC#Ig"
}

step() {   # step <name of step> <host> <name> <log folder> [args...]
  local s=$1 host=$2 name=$3 logs=$4; shift 4
}
```

```
	float HallCornerYaw(const FVector& A, const FVector& B)

			}
```

```
			TWeakObjectPtr<ASupercutRoom> WeakRoom(&Room);
			struct FAB { uint64 Frame = 0; double Time = 0; double Sum[2] = { 0, 0 }; uint64 Frames[2] = { 0, 0 }; };
			TSharedRef<FAB> AB = MakeShared<FAB>();
			for (int32 Step = 0; Step <= 10; ++Step)
			{
				FTimerHandle Handle;
				W->GetTimerManager().SetTimer(Handle, FTimerDelegate::CreateLambda([WeakRoom, AB, Step, W]()
				{
					const double Now = FPlatformTime::Seconds();
					if (Step > 0)

						const int32 State = (Step - 1) % 2;   // 0 hall built, 1 hall gone
						AB->Sum[State] += Now - AB->Time;
						AB->Frames[State] += GFrameCounter - AB->Frame;
					}
					if (Step == 10)

						UE_LOG(LogSupercut, Display, TEXT("SHELL1TMP AB hall built: %llu frames in %.2f s, %.3f ms; gone: %llu frames in %.2f s, %.3f ms"),

						return;
					}
					if (WeakRoom.IsValid())
					{
						if (Step % 2 == 1)
						{
							ASupercutHall::TearDownFor(*WeakRoom);
						}
						else if (Step > 0)
						{
							ASupercutHall::BuildFor(*WeakRoom);
						}
					}
					FTimerHandle Mark;
					W->GetTimerManager().SetTimer(Mark, FTimerDelegate::CreateLambda([AB]()
					{
						AB->Time = FPlatformTime::Seconds();
						AB->Frame = GFrameCounter;
					}), 0.3f, false);
				}), 3.f + Step * 2.f, false);
			}
		}
	}
	return Hall;'''.replace('\n','\r\n')
assert s.count('\treturn Hall;')==1
s=s.replace('\treturn Hall;',tmp,1)
```

```
int32 ASupercutHall::TearDownFor(ASupercutRoom& Room)
{
	int32 Count = 0;
	for (TActorIterator<ASupercutHall> Hall(Room.GetWorld()); Hall; ++Hall)
	{
		if (IsValid(*Hall) && Hall->Room == &Room)
		{
			Hall->Destroy();
			++Count;
		}
	}
	return Count;
```

```
- **Two separate runs on a farm PC do not compare.** [pc-c]'s load moves with a person and other lanes: the same package
  and room gave 142 and 198 fps an hour apart, and a run can start clean and get company halfway. The farm load check
  only holds at the start. To price one feature, compare inside one setting: either (a) toggle it in the same process
  every 2 s and count frames per state (temporary code), or (b) run the same package back to back with the feature
  off then on, twice, through a `Tuning.txt` beside the test exe (`F:\UE\Farm\_builds\<name>\Supercut59\Windows`;
  remove it after). Throw out any pair where `status` showed another game running.
- **Uncooked runs say little about cost.** Shaders still compile in the first seconds and the usage-flag fallback
  (litter1 section) does not happen, so a feature that halved a packaged game's frame rate cost about 1 percent there.
- **SUPERCUT is CPU-bound on [pc-c].** ProfileGPU in room 01: GPU frame about 1.8 ms while the frame is 5 to 9 ms. GPU
  work (instances, fog, unshadowed lights) shows little in the frame time; game-thread work shows all of it.
EOF
```

### Sat 14 Nov 23:16:41 · Agent (claude-opus-5-5)

The hall work is finished and committed on branch `shell1` in `D:\UE\wt\shell1`. There are three commits (`81a8f53`, `c849bb9`, `ba8ab10`), the tree is clean, and nothing was merged, rebased or pushed. Every room is now built inside a soundstage instead of a black void. It has a concrete floor, padded walls with columns and a stage door, a catwalk, scaffold towers, road-case stacks, a lighting truss with hanging lamps, a steel roof, four dim work lights and thin haze. It's all made by code from the room bounds, so the same code covers the 8 hand-made rooms and generated rooms.

**Checks:**
- **main8:** two runs from the final package both gave `RUN wrapped: takes 1, time 98.2 s, shots 46, freezes 14, kills 17`, equal to the reference. The hall was built in all 8 rooms each time.
- **Tests:** all 125 pass, including the six new hall tests. The last run was at 23:10 on the final code.
- **Material warnings:** two remain, `M_Solid` and `MI_Revolver_Round`. The base package gives the same two, so they aren't from the hall.
- **Room bounds:** the tests show no hall piece inside any room or its margin, in the 8 rooms and in 4 generated rooms.

**Frame time:** the hall costs under 15% everywhere I could measure cleanly, so nothing was cut. Two methods agree:
- Same package, hall off then on, back to back: room 03 +0.43 ms (about 9.5%), room 01 +0.25 to +0.38 ms (5 to 7.5%).
- Hall hidden and shown in the same game: 3.4% to 11.8%.

Two earlier room 01 pairs read worse (167 against 135 fps, 142 against 100). Another lane's games were running on [pc-c] then, so I didn't count them.

**One fix outside my own files:** a packaged game drew the hall with the engine's default material, because two existing materials (`M_PropReal` and `M_Glow`) weren't flagged for instancing. Editor runs hide this. I re-saved both with the flag, and a new test goes red if they lose it. props1's importer (`make_props_real.py`) and `make_assets.py` should set the flag too, or a regenerate breaks it. This is the main merge risk, because binary files can't be merged by hand.

**Pictures:** 61 JPGs in `lanes/shell1/shots/`, all reviewed against the brief's fault list:
- No void at eye height, no piece in a room, no floating pieces, no flattening light, no signal colours in the hall.
- One weak view: a test room that starts on a 14 m post looks straight at an unlit wall and comes out near black.
- At eye height with the 480 cm set walls, the hall shows mainly above the far walls and overhead. Side views show almost only the wall.
- In the freeze, the hall is one flat pencil tone and the set keeps its lines.

**Lower set walls `[taste: owner review]`:** I made a test copy of room 03 with 300 cm walls (`Content/Rooms/hall/lowflats/03_long_lens.txt`). No game room file was changed. Side views improve a lot: the catwalk, padded walls and a scaffold tower show over the set, and it reads as a set in a warehouse. Ahead and up views barely change. Nobody has played it, so whether lower walls change play is still open.

I also added a short note to `unreal/GOTCHAS.md` on measuring frame cost on a shared farm PC. I left LOG.md, HANDOFF.md and the pictures uncommitted, as the brief asks.
